palace_v2_revision.reason: User requested substantially more magnificent expansive imperial city, comparable to Asian and Middle Eastern palaces.
palace_v2_revision.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Revise infected European imperial palace into a truly VAST Byzantine imperial PALACE CITY, not a concentrated church-like single block. Image 1 and 2 are reference ONLY for vast horizontal complex scale and THREE STACKED ROW layout, image 3 establishes European architectural vocabulary and gray-brown stone/dark slate roofs/dark purple fungal infection palette. Output one wide landscape sheet with three full-width horizontal rows: FRONT top, BACK middle, RIGHT SIDE bottom. Each complete palace-city spans 95% of image width with 2.5% safe margin, same scale and full silhouette, no cropping, zero perspective true orthographic elevations. Architecture: expand actual compound at least fourfold horizontally relative to image 3: huge continuous defensive ramparts, many rhythmic square fortress towers, long double-storey arcaded palace wings, five connected palace courts at successive depths, multiple independent grand domed audience halls and pavilions, largest imperial central dome plus 8-12 lesser domes, colossal ceremonial central gate. Broad low silhouette, total width roughly 8 times maximum height, sprawling layered imperial seat comparable in scale to references 1 and 2. No minarets, no Chinese roofs, no turquoise tiles, no tiny isolated cathedral or single central block. Preserve desaturated gray-brown masonry, dark roofs, restrained purple-black cysts and black-brown root infection across entire compound. Distinct rear has extensive fortified service/imperial apartment facade rather than repeating front ceremonial gate; side expresses the full deep succession of courts and palace wings. Three views must represent the SAME complete structure. Plain pale gray neutral background, crisp detailed concept render, no landscape or people. Small labels FRONT, BACK, RIGHT SIDE in left margin of respective rows, clear blank horizontal gutters between rows for later cropping.

validation.layout: Three stacked full-width rows: FRONT / BACK / RIGHT SIDE
validation.result: Expanded actual palace compound with long arcaded wings, numerous domes and towers, extensive ramparts. Gray-brown stone, dark roofs, purple-black infection retained. Complete silhouette uncropped.
validation.crop_handoff: Original dimensions 2172 x 724; row boundaries approximately y=242 and y=474, verify at original resolution before cutting.
